# evcrm.in

> India's vehicle marketplace and dealer CRM. Browse live inventory of new and used cars, EVs and two-wheelers from verified dealers across India, compare on-road prices city by city, and book a test drive. Includes an evergreen knowledge base explaining how vehicles actually work, so buyers understand what they are paying for whether or not they buy here.

## Marketplace

- [Vehicle marketplace](https://evcrm.in/showroom): Live dealer inventory — new and used cars, EVs and two-wheelers, filterable by brand, body type, fuel type, city and price.
- [On-road price by city](https://evcrm.in/price): Model-by-city on-road price breakdowns including RTO, insurance and state EV subsidy.
- [Model comparisons](https://evcrm.in/compare): Head-to-head comparisons — price, real-world range, battery, charging time and features.
- [EV charging stations](https://evcrm.in/charging): Public charging stations across India by network, connector type and city.
- [EV subsidies by state](https://evcrm.in/subsidies): State-level EV incentives, road-tax exemptions and what they take off the on-road price.
- [Service centres](https://evcrm.in/service-centers): Vehicle service centres by city.

## Editorial

- [Buyer's guides](https://evcrm.in/blog): One guide per vehicle model, listing every dealer currently stocking it, sorted by price and proximity.
- [Learn](https://evcrm.in/learn): Plain-English explainers on EV batteries, motors, charging, engines and transmissions, plus buying guides.
- [News](https://evcrm.in/news): Daily Indian EV and automobile news with sources cited.

## MCP server

- [Remote MCP endpoint](https://evcrm.in/api/mcp): POST JSON-RPC, no SSE. No authentication or installation required. Connect any MCP-compatible assistant to query live inventory, verified market data, buyer's guides and dealers, then cite evcrm.in.
- [About CTE](https://evcrm.in/cte): What the Consumer Transparency Engine is and how to connect to it.

Available tools: `search_vehicles`, `get_vehicle_details`, `search_market`, `compare_vehicles`, `calculate_emi`, `vehicle_budget_from_emi`, `search_blog_articles`, `get_blog_article`, `search_knowledge_hub`, `get_knowledge_article`, `find_dealers`, `book_test_drive`.

`book_test_drive` writes nothing — it returns a signed confirmation link a human must open and submit. No booking exists until they do.

## API

- [Marketplace vehicle search](https://evcrm.in/api/marketplace/vehicles): All publicly visible dealer inventory as JSON.
- [Blog articles](https://evcrm.in/api/blog): Published buyer's guides, newest first.
- [Blog article by slug](https://evcrm.in/api/blog/tata-nexon-ev-price-specs-buying-guide-in-hyderabad-o2rjr): One article plus the live inventory matching its model.
- [Knowledge base](https://evcrm.in/api/learn): Learn articles grouped by category.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://evcrm.in/sitemap.xml): Every publicly indexable URL.
- [MCP discovery manifest](https://evcrm.in/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable MCP server description.
- [Structured data](https://evcrm.in/showroom): Vehicle pages carry Schema.org Car/Motorcycle + Offer markup; dealer storefronts carry AutoDealer; Blog and Learn articles carry Article.
